rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Official MCP server for the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform, providing over 280 tools for managing ZPA (Private Access), ZIA (Internet Access), ZDX (Digital Experience), ZCC (Client Connector), and EASM services. Supports read-only operations by default with opt-in write capabilities, and integrates with Claude Desktop, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Authenticates via Zscaler OneAPI credentials.
